required_invariant: A fully supplied near-limit HTTP body rejected for declared size receives a complete HTTP 413 response without dispatch or writes; the next healthy request works. The body limit remains 65536 bytes.

baseline.whole_raw_body_observation: 65537 and 66560 byte bodies each returned complete 413 responses in two attempts
baseline.fragment_schedule: Send the complete headers, then body in 1024 byte chunks with TCP_NODELAY and 1 millisecond between writes; half-close after the last byte
baseline.fragmented_observation: Both 65537 and 66560 byte bodies raised BrokenPipeError [Errno 32] while sending in two attempts each
baseline.state_and_recovery: Independent SQLite remained empty; GET /health returned 200/healthy after every attempted request

coverage_boundary: Near-limit fully supplied bodies are distinct from an arbitrary unbounded or silent sender; the latter only promises bounded release.
